model_card.summary: Full multimodal checkpoint after projector-only alignment with frozen language and encoders.
model_card.scope: trained projector with frozen self-trained encoders/language; failures remain evidence
limitations: Small generated tasks and fixed splits do not establish natural-image perception, speech recognition, general instruction following or broad multimodal reasoning.
Greedy generation and intervention scores are measured separately; successful loading on generated input is not accuracy evidence.
Frozen-language contract checks are separate from task accuracy; the six held-out describe answers are all incorrect despite lower token NLL.

This complete standalone checkpoint includes the synthetic SFT language model, both pre-trained synthetic encoders and projectors; only the image projector is updated in this branch. No external base checkpoint is required.

training.loss_probe: same deterministic batch before and after training
training.timing_scope: optimizer loop including logging, periodic local checkpoints and CUDA synchronization; excludes probes, evaluation and final file write

data.split_policy: all prompts derived from an image stay in its offset family
